findings.highlight: I want to save something between us
findings.evidenceJa: 確かなものを、セイバーとの間に残したかった
findings.governingReading: I wanted to leave something certain between Saber and me
findings.explanation: Shirou’s wish to create lasting proof of their bond becomes vague preservation of an existing thing.

findings.highlight: I guess that was my concern
findings.evidenceJa: こういうのも老婆心と言うのでしょうか
findings.governingReading: I suppose this is what one calls an old woman’s needless solicitude
findings.explanation: Saber’s self-conscious, gently comic characterization of her meddling disappears.

findings.highlight: I guess she’ll blush even more if I let her be
findings.evidenceJa: 一応理由を訊くコトにした
findings.governingReading: I decide that I had better ask her why
findings.explanation: Shirou’s resulting decision and the transition into his question disappear.

findings.governingReading: restoring my strength and fighting spirit
findings.explanation: Saber’s active preparation becomes generic rest.

findings.highlight: I wanted to see her face
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと時間を過ごしたかった
findings.governingReading: I wanted to spend time with Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou’s desire for shared time is narrowed to seeing Saber’s face.

findings.highlight: I come up with an excuse on a whim
findings.evidenceJa: 思いつきで、嘘のない気持ちを口にした
findings.governingReading: On impulse, I put an honest feeling into words
findings.explanation: mirror moon directly reverses truthful spontaneity into deception.

findings.highlight: but I want to drink tea with Saber
findings.evidenceJa: それ以上にセイバーとお茶が飲みたかった
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally supplies an explicit hierarchy of Shirou’s desire absent from the active Japanese.

findings.highlight: the wooden floor we used to train on
findings.evidenceJa: たった数日、けれど確かにセイバーと打ち合った、板張りの床
findings.governingReading: the wooden floor where, for only a few days, I had nevertheless truly crossed swords with Saber
findings.explanation: A brief, exact period of exchanging blows becomes unspecified habitual training.

findings.evidenceJa: ご機嫌ななめなセイバーのマスター
findings.governingReading: Saber’s Master, who seems to be in a bad mood
findings.explanation: Rin’s current mood becomes a stable defect of temperament.

findings.highlight: proof at all of Saber’s existence
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーがここにいた証
findings.governingReading: proof that Saber had been here
findings.explanation: Concrete evidence of Saber’s presence becomes metaphysical proof that she exists.

findings.evidenceJa: このなんでもなかった時間
findings.explanation: The cherished stretch of ordinary shared time becomes a belittled discrete event.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと仲良く話してたみたい
findings.governingReading: it looked as though you and Saber were enjoying an intimate conversation
findings.explanation: Rin’s pointed observation of their apparent closeness becomes neutral surveillance.

findings.evidenceJa: 静かにドアを開けて中に入った
findings.governingReading: I quietly open the door and enter
findings.explanation: The careful physical manner of Shirou’s entry disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 気になったものは仕方がない
findings.explanation: The alternate branch again turns Shirou’s curiosity into obligation.

findings.evidenceJa: さらに正体不明な回答をしやがった
findings.governingReading: she gives an even more inscrutable answer
findings.explanation: The alternate branch again weakens Shirou’s heightened bafflement and irritated voice.

findings.highlight: locks the door, and walks to the back of the room
findings.evidenceJa: がちゃん、と鍵をかけて、ずかずかと奥に戻る
findings.governingReading: locks the door with a click and strides heavily back into the room
findings.explanation: This branch repeats the omission of the audible lock and Rin’s forceful gait.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーには優しいのよね、衛宮くんは
findings.governingReading: You certainly are kind to Saber, Emiya-kun
findings.explanation: This branch again drops Rin’s pointed formal surname address.

findings.evidenceJa: 足止め役のセイバーが倒されたら
findings.governingReading: If Saber, whom we assigned to hold him off, is defeated
findings.explanation: This branch again removes Saber’s specific tactical assignment.

findings.highlight: used his riches to collect all the magic-resistant equipment in the world
findings.evidenceJa: 金にあかせて対魔術の武装を纏ってる
findings.governingReading: uses his wealth to outfit himself with anti-Magecraft armaments
findings.explanation: This branch repeats the invented exhaustive worldwide collection.
